name: Easy Jogging

instructions.description: Begin with an easy walk, then transition to a light jog.
Use short relaxed steps and land quietly.
Keep the shoulders and hands relaxed while breathing steadily.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Walk-Jog Intervals meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Easy Jogging.
Easy Jogging — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use a pace that allows controlled breathing and relaxed form.
